set.body:
R/fmri_lm_contrasts.R:260-268 advertises HC2 and HC3 in @param but both branches
warn "not implemented, using HC1" and return the HC1 adjustment. Either implement
them (both need only the hat-matrix diagonal) or reject the type instead of
returning a differently-defined estimator under the requested name.

Also note the multi-voxel branch averages the meat matrix across voxels
(R/fmri_lm_contrasts.R:271-278), producing one shared covariance rather than a
per-voxel one; calculate_sandwich_variance does the same via rowMeans. Document or
fix that limitation.
set.title: compute_sandwich_variance: HC2/HC3 silently degrade to HC1
